Author: Keinoshi
Description:
Notice (2026-01-23): I currently do not have plans to update this mod for the upcoming The Last Chieftains DLC. Thank you for playing and I hope you enjoyed the mod. Regards, Keinoshi
This is a scenario pack + data mod for CBA 6X Tech, adapted from Motz144's CBA 6X Gunpowder mod.
Note: For some reason, many people appear to be running the Mountain DLC V1-8E scenario together with this mod. The Mountain scenarios are no longer compatible (the prerequisite for cavalry archers, hand cannoneers, and elephant archers has changed) Please ensure you are running Alexander the Great DLC V1-0 or later (i.e. the scenarios included with the data mod, not old copies)
Please note that:

1. This mod only works in AOE2 mode. (Does not work in AOE1 mode)

2. This mod is designed to work with the included scenarios. While it can be used on other scenarios or on random map mode, it is not optimized for that purpose.
Since there are a number of complaints regarding compatibility with other mods, please also note that this is a data mod.

Unlike graphic mods, data mods are loaded only when the mod is activated for a specific game / lobby.

(This is the reason you cannot see and select the scenario files included with the mod until the data mod is selected for a game/lobby)

When a crash occurs for any reason, AOE2 disables all mods as a precaution. However, this does not mean there was a conflict with other mods.

It should be theoretically impossible for this (and any other data mod) to break the game or interfere with other mods in an unloaded state.
This mod is the
Title: 59728_6X Tech CBA Alexander the Great DLC
